intents.title: Studio v2.6: Soft Pill-Wedge Radial Map, Orbiting Dependencies, Interactive Dual Scrubber, and CodeMirror 6 Diff Engine
intents.statement: Port soft editorial tactile visual system and light/dark theme from AFWE Codebase Atlas. Implement pill-wedge geometry, layer/growth scaling, hover lineage fade, orbiting dependency pills, and rewind timeline in RadialMap. Re-use TopologyMap in Timeline & Turns for live Before/After diffs. Build interactive dual scrubber with range selection handles, pan, and wheel zoom. Implement CodeMirror 6 side-by-side diff viewer with language support and universal stream fallback tokenizer. Ensure timeline::diff delivers unified git hunks.
